descriptions.text: Quint – Level 75 Half-Djinn, Half-Garbage Scowl. Desperado Club Pharmacist. This is a non-combatant NPC. Half-Djinns are common on the forested levels of Dungeon Crawler World. Nobody knows for certain why there are so many hybrid Djinns out there, but one theory suggests that a rather ill-timed expletive is the cause of the population explosion. It is posited that a person in control of a Djinn's lamp and the resulting three wishes once exclaimed, "Fuck this forest" or "Fuck this level" or "Fuck you all" or some iteration thereof, and the enslaved genie took that as a challenge. As a result, thousands of half-Djinn, half-forest creatures roam the dungeon. Only a few are intelligent. Only a few are sane. They are all dangerous little fuckers. If you kill too many of them, rumor has it their daddy may come looking for you.

recap.text: Mordecai sends a barefoot human and a talking cat to Quint, a manager who wants a starter kit. The cat, drunk on cherries, negotiates a trade for a Rev-Up that costs three bottles of moonshine and a Hair of the Dog. Quint tells the human about a crawler with one goat leg and two dogs who froze a playroom, stole tequila, and splattered the brains of an elite gnoll with a mace.

beats.headline: A starter kit for three bottles of moonshine
beats.text: Mordecai has me sent over to his table with a barefoot human and a talking cat, which is the sort of shift I am having, and I have not seen the man in years. He is a manager now. Sweet gig, that. No AI breathing down your back. He wants my starter kit. I want the Rev-Up in the human's inventory, because that Krakaren told me no more of it was being made this season. I ask four bottles. The cat, drunk on the cherries, talks me down to three and a Hair of the Dog. Deal.
beats.gist: Mordecai sends a barefoot human and a talking cat to Quint, who trades three bottles of moonshine.

beats.headline: What he says about the girl with the dogs
beats.text: The human asks about last night, so I tell him. A crawler came in, a real looker with one goat leg and two dogs. She put the dogs in the playroom and they went bonkers, she froze the whole room with a spell, stole tequila from behind my counter and splattered the brains of an elite gnoll with a mace. The playroom is shut for a week. Her membership has been revoked, thank the gods. The human knows her name before I have finished.
beats.gist: Quint tells a human about a crawler with one goat leg and two dogs.
